run_f_gold_search: run f_gold to search for a target value in a row-wise and column-wise sorted matrix
test_f_gold: test f_gold with multiple matrix and target value parameter sets
create_f_filled: create f_filled function that replicates the staircase search algorithm from f_gold
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to return coordinates instead of printing them
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which uses staircase search on a sorted 2D matrix
